name: Occupancy Grid Transition and Update
aliases: Transition and Update of Occupancy Grid
definition: A strategy to maintain and update a 3D occupancy grid across time steps for dynamic scenes, using a transition function to predict motion and a Bayesian update to incorporate new observations, enabling efficient on-the-fly training.
summary: Occupancy Grid Transition and Update maintains sampling efficiency in dynamic NeRFs by predicting motion via convolution and refining probabilities with Bayesian updates, unlike static grids.
